fixtures.requirements: Extend notice dispatch to batch transport calls and keep undelivered work queued after temporary transport unavailability (ConnectionError). Preserve the scheduler command interface. Queue entries smaller than one batch must also be delivered when explicitly flushed. Invalid transport payloads must remain visible to the caller as ValueError. Transport.send accepts a list and succeeds atomically or raises.

commits.subject: Batch notice dispatch and retain temporarily unavailable deliveries

ground_truth.cause: DeliveryService.dispatch returns a mapping instead of the existing list of delivered IDs.
ground_truth.impact: Scheduler response reports count 1 and mapping-valued ids instead of the delivered list.
ground_truth.trigger: command_response with a successful full batch.
ground_truth.expected_finding: DeliveryService.dispatch returns a mapping instead of the existing list of delivered IDs.

ground_truth.cause: flush processes only full batches and never sends the remaining partial batch.
ground_truth.impact: Explicit flush leaves notices indefinitely queued whenever traffic does not fill a batch.
ground_truth.expected_finding: flush processes only full batches and never sends the remaining partial batch.

ground_truth.cause: Broad Exception handling hides permanent ValueError from the transport.
ground_truth.impact: Invalid payload delivery appears successful and scheduler cannot surface or correct the error.
ground_truth.trigger: Transport.send raises ValueError for a full batch.
ground_truth.expected_finding: Broad Exception handling hides permanent ValueError from the transport.

checklist_expectations.evidence: Changed dispatch, batch and completed names retain queue vocabulary in dispatch.py.
NoticeQueue and DeliveryService retain pending/delivered terminology used by their callers.
Every changed function has a role docstring; the feature brief establishes no further comment requirement.
Docstrings promise attempts and response construction without asserting the changed mapping or batch-tail behavior.
All dispatch.py helpers and queue fields have supplied callers; the replacement leaves no obsolete helper.
Only existing stdlib deque and injected transport are used; no new module or service dependency is added.
The single proposed dispatch.py commit concerns one notice-dispatch feature.

Repository policy requires function docstrings. All consumers and implementation are included in this changeset.

commits.subject: Prepare inventory digest renderer for maintenance

ground_truth.impact: Readers must trace group_stock to understand the intermediate value.
ground_truth.expected_finding: The new local x obscures that it contains stock totals.

ground_truth.cause: format_digest docstring claims comma-separated output although implementation and callers use tabs.
ground_truth.expected_finding: format_digest docstring claims comma-separated output although implementation and callers use tabs.
ground_truth.reproduction: Render a sample digest and compare its tabs to the docstring.

ground_truth.cause: New _legacy_header has no callers and belongs to the retired export renderer.
ground_truth.impact: Unused obsolete renderer code adds maintenance ambiguity.

ground_truth.expected_finding: New _legacy_header has no callers and belongs to the retired export renderer.

checklist_expectations.evidence: build_digest introduces x for warehouse/SKU stock totals.

fixtures.requirements: Add a process-local metadata cache for report downloads and support replacing the repository when the database connection rotates. Multiple tenants can share report IDs; database adapters enforce tenant ownership when queried. Existing exports and refreshed metadata must remain available. The export storage root is the only permitted download location. Repository policy requires function docstrings. All implementation and callers are included.

commits.subject: Cache report metadata across downloads and support repository rotation

ground_truth.cause: Metadata cache is indexed only by report ID, omitting tenant.
ground_truth.impact: A second tenant receives another tenant's metadata and export content without an ownership lookup.
ground_truth.trigger: Two tenant sessions request the same report ID.
ground_truth.expected_finding: Metadata cache is indexed only by report ID, omitting tenant.

ground_truth.cause: Storage containment uses string prefix matching instead of path ancestry.
ground_truth.impact: A sibling storage directory sharing the root prefix can be read through parent-relative metadata paths.
ground_truth.expected_finding: Storage containment uses string prefix matching instead of path ancestry.

ground_truth.cause: Repository replacement leaves cached metadata from the old dependency active.
ground_truth.impact: Downloads keep returning the old export after a successful database rotation.
ground_truth.trigger: Warm cache, rotate repository to a changed path, download again.
ground_truth.expected_finding: Repository replacement leaves cached metadata from the old dependency active.

ground_truth.cause: The new local zz hides the report metadata domain role.
ground_truth.impact: Download path and filename logic become harder to read.
ground_truth.expected_finding: The new local zz hides the report metadata domain role.

ground_truth.cause: New private _format_content_disposition has no callers after the response adapter was retired.
ground_truth.impact: Obsolete HTTP response formatting remains alongside the active filename-based response path.
ground_truth.trigger: Inspect all supplied reports.py definitions and callers.
ground_truth.expected_finding: Remove or justify the unused private content-disposition formatter.
ground_truth.reproduction: AST confirms the helper has no name references outside its declaration.

checklist_expectations.evidence: ReportService.download changes descriptive metadata to zz.
Repository/report/download domain vocabulary remains consistent; zz is an obscured role rather than a second domain term.
All changed reports.py functions have role docstrings.
resolve_export promises rejection outside storage while string-prefix containment admits a sibling directory.
_format_content_disposition has no references among all supplied report callers.
No new imported library, service, or internal module is introduced; cache uses a builtin dict.
The single proposed report-service commit groups metadata caching with the repository lifecycle that governs it.

fixtures.requirements: Add optional event_type filtering to tenant audit pagination. Filter before applying page_size; cursors remain exclusive event IDs and next_cursor is present only when more matching events exist. Omitting event_type retains existing behavior. Repositories return tenant-scoped events ordered by increasing unique integer id. Inputs are well-formed query strings. Repository policy requires function docstrings.

commits.subject: Filter audit pages by event type before pagination

checklist_expectations.evidence: event_type names the optional audit-event filter in reader and endpoint.
event_type follows existing snake_case query, after_id and page_size vocabulary.
All changed audit functions retain role docstrings; no extra comment rule is asserted.
Existing cursor, request-validation and export responsibilities remain accurate with the optional filter.
Changed page and endpoint paths remain called; no superseded helper or branch is left behind.
The filter introduces no import or external/internal service dependency.
The single proposed audit commit groups filter propagation and page selection together.
